title: The planets in order
examples: Which planet do we live on?
What is the order of the planets?
Can you show me the planets from the Sun?

explain.say: Mercury is the first planet from the Sun. It is also the smallest planet.
Now look. This is the solar system in 3D. Can you see the Sun and Mercury? Tap any part to hear about it.
Next is Venus. Venus is the hottest planet. It looks very bright in the sky.
The third planet is Earth. Earth is the only planet where we know there is life.
The fourth planet is Mars. People call Mars the red planet.
Then come the giants: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune. Jupiter is the biggest.
Saturn has rings made of ice and rock. You can see them with a telescope.

faq.q: Which planet is the biggest one in our solar system?
faq.a: Jupiter is the biggest planet. It is much larger than all the other planets combined.
asks: Which planet is the giant one?

faq.q: What are the rings on Saturn made of?
faq.a: The rings on Saturn are made mostly of chunks of ice and some small pieces of rock.

faq.q: What is the order of the planets from the Sun?
faq.a: The order is Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.
asks: Can you list the planets in order?

faq.a: No, Mercury is the smallest planet. Earth is the third planet from the Sun.

faq.q: Do all the planets have rings?
faq.a: No. Saturn has the brightest rings. Jupiter, Uranus and Neptune have thin, faint rings.

facts: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun.
Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
Earth is the third planet from the Sun.
Saturn is famous for its visible ring system.

quiz.say: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
quiz.why: Mercury is the first planet from the Sun.

wrong.0: Venus is second, just after Mercury.
wrong.2: Earth is third from the Sun.

quiz.say: Which planet has big, bright rings?
quiz.why: Saturn's rings are made of ice and rock. They are bright and wide.

wrong.0: Jupiter has only thin, faint rings.
wrong.1: Mars is the red planet, with no rings.

quiz.say: Count the planets from the Sun. Which one comes after Mars?
quiz.why: The order goes Mars, then Jupiter.
